adventure.title: Lost Temple of Shadows
adventure.synopsis: A crumbling temple to a forgotten shadow god stirs beneath the old harbour district. Cultists have awakened something dormant, and the players must descend into its depths before the ritual is complete.

assets.caption: A wax-sealed letter bearing the shadow cult's mark

chapters.title: The Harbour District
chapters.synopsis: The players arrive at the harbour and begin piecing together the cult's activities.

rooms.name: Entry Hall
rooms.readAloud: The heavy stone door grinds open to reveal a vaulted chamber thick with stale air. Torchlight flickers from iron sconces, casting long shadows across the carved bas-reliefs that line the walls — figures prostrating before a great, formless dark.
rooms.gmNotes: The cultists use this room as a checkpoint. Anyone entering without the shadow cult's sigil tattooed on their wrist is attacked on sight. The bas-reliefs provide a DC 18 Religion check to identify the forgotten deity Noctiveth.

connections.description: a heavy iron door, slightly ajar
connections.requirement: DC 18 Athletics to force if locked

skillChecks.description: Notice a loose flagstone near the east wall
skillChecks.success: The PC finds a leather satchel containing 12 gp and a vial of antiplague.

skillChecks.description: Identify the deity depicted in the bas-reliefs
skillChecks.success: The carvings depict Noctiveth, a shadow deity formally stricken from the Starstone pantheon three centuries ago.
skillChecks.failure: The deity is unfamiliar — ancient and clearly proscribed.

sounds.description: Distant dripping water and the occasional scrape of stone

background: Slow dripping water echoing off stone
ambience.combatTrack: Tense percussive score with low drone

rooms.name: Inner Sanctum
rooms.readAloud: A circular chamber opens before you. At its centre, a basin of dark liquid reflects the ceiling — a mosaic of stars with one constellation conspicuously scratched out. The air smells of iron and burned wax.
rooms.gmNotes: The basin contains shadow-infused blood. Disturbing it triggers the Desecrated Basin hazard. The High Priestess Vexa is here unless already encountered elsewhere.

connections.description: the iron door back to the entry hall

skillChecks.success: The ritual is half-complete. Disrupting the basin now will delay it by 24 hours and deal 4d6 negative damage to anyone within 10 feet.
skillChecks.failure: The magic is too complex to read quickly.

background: A low, resonant hum from the basin
Soft whispers at the edge of perception

npcs.name: Captain Aldric Marrow
npcs.personality: Coldly professional. Speaks in clipped sentences. Deeply loyal to Vexa despite knowing the ritual is wrong.
npcs.publicKnowledge: A former city guard captain, dismissed two years ago for 'conduct unbecoming.' Now runs the cult's muscle. Recognised by his distinctive scar running from left ear to jaw.
npcs.secrets: Marrow was blackmailed into joining — Vexa holds evidence of a killing he committed while on the guard. He would betray the cult if given a way out and immunity.
npcs.tactics: Marrow leads from the front but retreats when below 20 HP to warn Vexa. He will not fight to the death — offer of parley at 50% HP buys a one-round pause.
npcs.voiceNotes: Flat, quiet baritone. Barely moves his face. Pauses before answering anything.

actions.name: Power Attack
actions.description: Marrow makes a Strike. This counts as two attacks for the multiple attack penalty. If this Strike hits, deal an extra die of weapon damage.

actions.name: Veteran's Eye
actions.trigger: An enemy within 30 feet makes an attack roll against one of Marrow's allies.
actions.description: Marrow calls out a warning. The ally gains a +1 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.

npcs.name: High Priestess Vexa
npcs.personality: Grandiose and utterly certain of her divine mandate. Treats interruptions as confirmation the uninitiated cannot comprehend.
npcs.publicKnowledge: Known only as a rumour among harbour dockworkers — 'the woman in grey who pays for silence.'
npcs.secrets: Vexa is not a true believer. She discovered the ritual three years ago and has been engineering its completion to gain the power Noctiveth promises. She will attempt to bargain if reduced below 30 HP.
npcs.tactics: Opens with Fear on the most martial-looking PC. Focuses Harm on whoever is disrupting the ritual. Uses Sanctuary on herself the moment she drops below half HP.
npcs.voiceNotes: Rich, theatrical contralto. Addresses everyone as 'child.' Laughs at threats.

actions.name: Shade Step
actions.description: Vexa steps into shadow and reappears in an unoccupied space within 30 feet that is in dim light or darkness.

encounters.name: Cult Checkpoint
encounters.tactics: Goblins rush the nearest PC. Marrow hangs back and uses Veteran's Eye before wading in with Power Attack on round 2.

custom.description:
A slender dagger whose blade seems to drink in light. Strikes made in dim light or darkness deal an additional 1d4 negative damage.

When the wielder is in darkness, the dagger can be drawn as a free action once per round.
A heavy bronze key stamped with the shadow cult's mark. Opens the locked iron door to Area A2.

hazards.name: Desecrated Ritual Basin

disable.description: Speak the proscription rite of Noctiveth (requires the text from Handout H1) to seal the basin. On a critical failure the basin erupts immediately.

actions.name: Shadow Eruption
actions.trigger: A creature touches the basin or disrupts the liquid within.
actions.description: The basin erupts with negative energy. All creatures within 10 feet take 4d6 negative damage (DC 22 basic Reflex save).

hazards.description: A circular stone basin filled with shadow-infused blood. It radiates moderate necromantic magic and is warm to the touch.
hazards.gmNotes: The basin is central to Vexa's ritual. Destroying it (reducing HP to 0) ends the ritual permanently but triggers Shadow Eruption as an immediate reaction. The PCs can disable it safely with the Religion check above, but only if they have the proscription text from Handout H1.

handouts.name: H1 — Proscription Rite of Noctiveth
handouts.content:
In Necril, in an archaic dialect:

"I name thee cast out. I name thee forgotten. By the light of every living star, I seal thee in the dark between worlds. Speak not. Walk not. Be not. Noctiveth, thou art ended."
handouts.foundLocation: A1. Entry Hall — inside the leather satchel beneath the loose flagstone (Perception DC 16 to find)
